# OFF — Open Freedom Forum

> OFF is a real-time, pseudonymous community platform for technical conversations.
> It collects less, is open about its limits, and hosts open communities plus
> country and interest rooms.

## Key facts

- Pseudonym-first: no real-name requirement. Optional personal details are stored
  separately from the public profile and gated by per-field visibility.
- No ads, no surveillance stack, no session replay, no behavioral analytics.
- Privacy features are described precisely — never marketed as anonymity guarantees.
- Built with React on Supabase, deployed as a static bundle on Cloudflare Workers.

## Product pages

- [Home](https://off.testingver.workers.dev/): entry point and sign-in.
- [Sign in](https://off.testingver.workers.dev/auth): create an account or sign in.

_PROFILE_: member profiles live under `https://off.testingver.workers.dev/u/{username}`.
